events.summary: Phyrexian portals roar open and a Vodalian knight prays to Svyelun for strength to cleanse the sky.
events.quote: As Phyrexian portals roared open, she whispered a prayer to Svyelun for the strength to cleanse the sky.

events.summary: Kaldheim's corrupted World Tree essence becomes the seed of New Phyrexia's Realmbreaker.
events.quote: The corrupted essence of Kaldheim's World Tree became the seed from which New Phyrexia's Realmbreaker grew.

events.summary: Across many worlds, millions witness the same impossible horror as the invasion begins.
events.quote: Across many worlds, millions of eyes witnessed the same impossible horror.

events.summary: Teferi hears Wrenn's call; a few Zhalfirins were already roused by a strange song.
events.quote: Even before Teferi heard Wrenn's call, a few Zhalfirins were roused from sleep by a strange, otherworldly song.

events.summary: Emrakul is imprisoned in the moon.
events.quote: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

events.summary: Urza turns down Titania's peace offer; Mishra makes her people pay.
events.quote: When Titania offered peace, Urza merely turned her down.

events.summary: As the Eldrazi spread, Zendikar's defenders seek any advantageous secret.
events.quote: As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.

events.summary: Sheoldred warns that a world will bow to Phyrexia as Mirrodin did.
events.quote: As with Mirrodin, your world will bow to Phyrexia.

events.summary: Yawgmoth offered a simple trade centuries ago.
events.quote: Centuries ago, a mad god offered a simple trade.

events.summary: Olivia makes an example of villages refusing her blood tithe.
events.quote: Olivia was quick to make an example of any village that refused to pay her blood tithe.

events.summary: Liliana whispers to the remaining consciousness of Oketra and Bontu.
events.quote: Liliana whispered to whatever consciousness Oketra and Bontu had left.

events.summary: Narset struggles to meditate while dragonlings spiral around her.
events.quote: As Narset struggled to meditate, tiny dragonlings spiraled around her, conjuring thoughts of ancient clans.

events.summary: Ugin tells Jace the Eldrazi can be imprisoned.
events.quote: "You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin.

relations.note: fought together in defense of Llanowar
relations.quote: Between the angel's blade and the elf's bow, few Phyrexians made it as far as Llanowar's canopy.

relations.note: destined to serve at her side
relations.quote: My destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side.
"I stand with every member of my clan, and they stand with me."
